name: Opacity-Gated, Annealed Densification
tagline: AbsGrad + (avg, max)-blended growth signal with an annealed threshold and an opacity gate; uses revised-opacity split.
init_recovers: Taming-3DGS at progress=0.6, opacity gate off.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two pieces on top of the Taming/AbsGS template: (i) a linear time-annealed growth threshold τ(t) = grow_grad2d·(1.3 − 0.5·progress), and (ii) an opacity gate σ(o) > 0.05 that suppresses growth on barely-visible Gaussians; everything else (avg/max blend, revised_opacity split, prune rules) inherits from Taming.

name: Percentile + Blur-Aware Densification
tagline: AbsGS with a sliding-window percentile growth threshold and forced splitting of large screen-space Gaussians.

key_hyperparams.name: noise_injection_until
key_hyperparams.role: declared but unused in code path

diff_from_baseline: Replaces the fixed grow_grad2d threshold with the running 80th-percentile of per-step gradient norms (adaptive), and adds a blur-aware forced split on Gaussians whose mean screen-space radius exceeds 10 px regardless of gradient — AbsGS keeps a constant threshold and never force-splits on radius.

name: AbsGS + Revised-Opacity Split
tagline: Plain AbsGS densification with mathematically consistent (revised-opacity) splitting and a slightly lower prune threshold.
init_recovers: AbsGS baseline when revised_opacity=False and prune_opa=0.005.
diff_from_baseline: Just AbsGS plus the revised_opacity=True split (Rota Bulo et al.); compared to the Taming baseline it drops the avg/max gradient blend and lowers prune_opa from 0.005 to 0.003 with reset value pinned at 0.01.

name: Rarity-Boosted Densification
tagline: Taming (avg/max) blend with a per-Gaussian visibility-rarity multiplier on the growth threshold.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a per-Gaussian visibility-rarity reweighting (1 + 0.5·rarity) on the growth threshold so frequently-seen Gaussians need stronger evidence to densify; otherwise mirrors Taming-3DGS-Abs (avg=0.7, max=0.3) with the standard stochastic split (no revised_opacity).

name: Curriculum Blend + Growth Cap
tagline: AbsGS with a time-rising threshold, time-decreasing max-grad weight, and a hard top-k cap on per-step growth.

key_hyperparams.name: max_grow_ratio
key_hyperparams.role: per-step cap on new Gaussians (frac of N)

init_recovers: Taming-3DGS-Abs at progress=0 (τ = grow_grad2d, w_max=0.3, no growth cap).
diff_from_baseline: Adds a curriculum on top of Taming/AbsGS: linear-in-time growth threshold τ(t) = base·(1+progress), linear decay of the max-gradient blend weight, and a top-k cap that limits per-refinement growth to 0.5% of current Gaussians; uses revised_opacity=True split.
